description: The body of a flow pull request still shows Agent N/A and Model N/A in its Plan & Validation Metadata section after the change that made the runner reach the body generator. The pull request body is written only by the review loop through the semantic PR text built from the intent, the plan stage payload and the runner, so the value that reaches the rendered line is still empty or a placeholder on the path that wrote the merged body.
goal: Find which source supplies the Agent and Model lines on the real path that writes the flow pull request body (the plan stage payload, the runner passed by the review loop, or the intent) and fix it in sandbox_executor/flow/github/pr_metadata.py and sandbox_executor/flow/review/ensemble.py so every body write, creation and review-loop edit, renders the runner that planned the flow. A placeholder such as N/A or an empty string in a higher-precedence source must not hide a real value in a lower one; keep the plan payload first when it holds a real value, and render N/A only when the value is absent in every source. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: The pull request is what the maintainer reads; showing N/A for the agent and model hides which runner produced the change.
acceptance_criteria: A new flow PR shows the real agent and model (e.g. `claude-agent` / `claude-opus-5-5`) in "Plan & Validation Metadata" on the PR as it appears on GitHub.
A test drives the PR body write path with a plan record loaded from a real plan file (not an inline dict) and asserts the agent and model lines.
`N/A` appears only when the value is genuinely unknown.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_pr_body_real_agent_model.py renders the body through apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/ensemble.py and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/github/pr_metadata.py for a plan payload whose agent and model are the placeholder N/A and a runner of claude-agent and claude-opus-5-5, and asserts the body shows the runner values, and shows N/A only when plan, runner and intent all lack the value.
No docstrings or comments except `# why:`.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes.
